text: Some items aren't on our shelf. We order them on the vendor's site, like Royal Canin food through My Royal Canin, and the vendor ships it straight to the client.
Place the order on their site, then type their order number here.
Nothing leaves our building, so there's no label to buy. It goes straight to check.
Items we always order this way can be set in the catalog to pass through by default, with the vendor filled in.
Then tell the client when to expect it, as for any order.
The most common mistakes: marking it filled before ordering on the vendor's site, and leaving out their order number.
Remember: order on their site first, then record the site and their order number.
